en.name: Bacon grease
en.summary: Bacon grease keeps 6 months in the fridge at 4 °C (40 °F) or below and 12 months in the freezer at −18 °C (0 °F). It is a rendered animal fat, so it fails by going rancid — but unlike a pure oil it carries meat particles, and those are what shorten it.
en.pantry: No pantry timeline is given for bacon grease, and the old habit of keeping a tin by the stove is the worst possible version of it. Warmth and light accelerate rancidity, and drippings straight from the pan carry browned meat particles and water from the bacon — both of which support spoilage in a way pure fat does not. If you are going to keep it at all, strain it hot through a fine sieve or muslin into a clean jar, let it set, and refrigerate it.
en.fridge: 6 months at 4 °C (40 °F) or below in a clean, sealed jar. Strain it while it is still liquid: the sediment at the bottom of the pan is meat solids and moisture, and a jar with a dark layer at the bottom will turn before a clean one does. Keep it sealed — bacon fat picks up fridge odours readily and passes them on to whatever you cook in it. Spoon it out with a clean dry spoon, never one that has been in a pan, and never pour fresh hot drippings into a jar of old cold grease.
en.freezer: 12 months at −18 °C (0 °F), double the fridge, and the sensible choice if you render a large batch at once. Freeze it in small portions — an ice cube tray then a bag works well — so you can take a spoonful at a time without thawing the lot. Kept continuously frozen it stays safe well beyond that window; what runs out is flavour, as the fat slowly oxidises even in the cold and eventually smells stale rather than smoky.
en.thawing: Take out a frozen portion and use it straight from the freezer in a hot pan, or let it soften in the fridge. Do not thaw a whole jar on the counter and refreeze the remainder; take out only what you need.
spoilage: A sharp, crayon or paint-like smell — rancid fat, and decisive.
A bitter or metallic taste in whatever you fry in it.
Any mould on the surface or around the rim, which means the whole jar goes out.
Water separating out or a sour smell, usually from grease that was not strained.
tips: Strain it hot through muslin; the meat particles are what shorten its life.
Use a clean dry spoon every time, and never a spoon that has touched a pan.
Freeze in small portions rather than keeping one large jar.
Do not top up an old jar with fresh hot drippings — start a new one.

faq.q: How long does bacon grease keep?
faq.a: 6 months in the fridge at 4 °C (40 °F) or below, or 12 months in the freezer at −18 °C (0 °F), in a clean sealed jar.

faq.q: Can you keep bacon grease at room temperature?
faq.a: No timeline is given for it, and the jar by the stove is the worst version — warmth speeds up rancidity and unstrained drippings carry meat particles and water. Strain it and refrigerate it.

faq.q: How do you know bacon grease has gone off?
faq.a: Smell it. A sharp, crayon-like note means it is rancid. Mould, water separating out or a sour smell all mean the jar goes in the bin.

zh.name: 培根油
zh.summary: 培根油放 4 °C 以下冷藏可放 6 個月，−18 °C 冷凍是 12 個月。它是熬出來的動物性油脂，所以失敗方式是油耗——但和純油不同的是，它裡面混著肉屑，而那正是縮短它壽命的東西。
zh.pantry: 培根油沒有給常溫期限；而「在爐邊放一個油罐」這個老習慣，正是最糟的那個版本。溫度和光會加速油耗，而剛從鍋裡倒出來的油還帶著焦化的肉屑和培根本身的水分——這兩樣都會支持腐敗，而純油脂不會。真的要留的話，請趁熱用細網或紗布濾進乾淨的罐子，放涼凝固後冷藏。
zh.fridge: 裝乾淨的密封罐、放 4 °C 以下 6 個月。趁還是液體時就過濾：鍋底那層沉澱是肉屑和水分，而罐底有一層深色沉澱的油，一定比乾淨的那罐更早壞。請密封——培根油很會吸冰箱的味道，然後原封不動帶進你用它炒的每一道菜。取用要用乾淨的乾湯匙，絕對不要用剛從鍋裡撈起來的那支；也絕對不要把新熱油直接倒進裝著舊冷油的罐子。
zh.freezer: −18 °C 下 12 個月，是冷藏的兩倍；一次熬了一大批的話，這是合理的選擇。請分成小份冷凍——用製冰盒凍好再裝袋很好用——這樣要一匙就拿一匙，不必整罐解凍。只要全程沒退冰，超過這段時間仍然安全；先用完的是風味，因為油脂在低溫下仍會慢慢氧化，最後聞起來只剩陳味而沒有煙燻香。
zh.thawing: 拿一份出來直接丟進熱鍋，或放冷藏回軟。不要把整罐放在檯面上解凍、用完再凍回去；要多少拿多少。
spoilage: 聞起來刺鼻、像蠟筆或油漆味——油耗了，而且是決定性的。
用它炒出來的東西帶苦味或金屬味。
表面或罐口出現霉，整罐丟掉。
析出水分或聞起來發酸，通常是沒過濾乾淨造成的。
tips: 趁熱用紗布過濾；縮短它壽命的就是那些肉屑。
每次都用乾淨的乾湯匙，絕對不要用碰過鍋子的那支。
分小份冷凍，不要只留一大罐。
不要把新的熱油加進舊罐子裡——重開一罐。

faq.a: 裝乾淨密封罐，4 °C 以下冷藏 6 個月，或 −18 °C 冷凍 12 個月。
它沒有給常溫期限，而放在爐邊是最糟的做法——溫度加速油耗，沒過濾的油又帶著肉屑和水分。請過濾後冷藏。
聞一下。刺鼻、像蠟筆的味道就是油耗。長霉、析出水分或發酸，都代表整罐該丟。

faq.q: 像放豬油那樣，把培根油裝罐子擺在爐邊可以嗎？
faq.a: 不要。那個習慣本來就假設一個涼爽的廚房，而台灣夏天室溫三十幾度、爐邊更熱，熱和光正是把油推向油耗的兩件事。更關鍵的是培根油不是純油：剛倒出來的裡面混著焦掉的肉屑和培根本身的水分，罐底那層深色沉澱會先發酸、長霉，純豬油不會這樣。要留就趁熱用細網或紗布濾乾淨，放涼凝固後密封冰進 4 °C 以下，那裡是 6 個月。
